CREATE TYPE "public"."PortalRole" AS ENUM ('OWNER', 'COMMITTEE', 'ADVISER', 'SUPPLIER')

CREATE TABLE "public"."account_codes" (
  "account_sub_type" text,
  "account_type" text NOT NULL,
  "code" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "fund_id" uuid,
  "gst_applicable" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "is_system_account" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "parent_account_id" uuid,
  "scheme_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."activity_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" uuid,
  "entity_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "scheme_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."announcements" (
  "author_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "expires_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_pinned" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'NORMAL' NOT NULL,
  "published_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "scheme_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bank_transactions" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "balance" numeric(12,2),
  "bank_account_id" uuid NOT NULL,

  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "import_batch_id" uuid,
  "import_source" text NOT NULL,
  "imported_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "matched_by" uuid,
  "matched_journal_entry_id" uuid,
  "reconciliation_status" text DEFAULT 'UNMATCHED' NOT NULL,
  "reference" character varying(100),
  "scheme_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "transaction_date" date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."budget_lines" (
  "account_code_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "budget_amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "financial_year" int4 NOT NULL,
  "fund_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bylaws" (
  "amended_date" timestamptz,

  "bylaw_number" int4 NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comments" (
  "author_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "work_order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

  "deleted_at" timestamptz,

  "due_date" timestamptz,

  "last_checked" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "scheme_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."contacts" (
  "address" text,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "company" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documents" (

  "deleted_at" timestamptz,

CREATE TABLE "public"."financial_periods" (

CREATE TABLE "public"."invitations" (

  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "public"."invoices" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,

  "due_date" timestamptz,

CREATE TABLE "public"."levies" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
